siteTitle: GeneGuidelines — Living guidelines for rare genetic diseases
siteDescription: Living guidelines, specialists, and clinical trials for rare genetic diseases.
citation: Javaid MK et al., Best practice management guidelines for fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome, Orphanet J Rare Dis 2019;14:139 (PMID 31196103).

fd.title: Fibrous dysplasia (FD/MAS)
fd.description: Fibrous dysplasia and McCune-Albright syndrome: the official FD/MAS guideline, doctors with documented experience, clinical trials and foundations — gathered by the GeneQuest Foundation.

fdMap.title: FD/MAS: a map for a parent after the diagnosis
fdMap.description: What exists after an FD/MAS diagnosis that nobody tells you about: how the diagnosis is confirmed, questions for your doctor with the verbatim guideline sentences behind them, doctors, guidelines, foundations and trials.

fdTests.title: FD/MAS: baseline evaluation — a printable list of tests
fdTests.description: To print: the tests the FD/MAS guideline (Javaid 2019) names in the baseline evaluation — each with the verbatim sentence behind it and an empty box for a result and a date.

fdGuidelines.title: FD/MAS: what the official guideline says
fdGuidelines.description: A summary of the official FD/MAS guideline (Javaid 2019, PMID 31196103) and the literature, with a link to every source. It is not an official guideline — the GeneQuest Foundation wrote it.
